title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that…
description: phpMyFAQ versions 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 have a missing authentication vulnerability. This flaw allows attackers with a hijacked session to enroll passkeys by exploiting the session and webauthn CSRF token. By calling specific API endpoints, attackers can replace the legitimate owner's passkeys, enabling persistent passwordless login that remains effective even after password changes or resets.
